scope_comparison: Need exact momentum stress with no defect, arbitrary data on bounded 3D domain and sigma L-infinity L2 / L2 H1. Generalized measures, quadratic elastic-energy changes, compressible, creeping 2D, or small-data fractional diffusion models do not cover original constitutive law.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. Current primary generalized theorem and October fractional theorem retain distinct limitations.
